quarterly_data.quarter: Ginkgo Bioworks press release: Ginkgo Bioworks Joins ARPA-H GIVE Program to Build (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ginkgo was awarded a subcontract for up to $17.5M under ARPA-H's GIVE program as subcontractor to prime contractor Waterfall Scientific on ESCALATOR, an autonomous benchtop manufacturing system for individualized RNA medicines (four custom modules - cell-free DNA template production, RNA synthesis, LNP encapsulation, fill and finish - coupled to an in-line QC subsystem of approximately twenty analytical instruments). Ginkgo will build the automation hardware, systems integration and control software, using its RACs and extending Catalyst software to run the whole system with GMP-grade data integrity and audit trail. The program is phased (design and engineering, then build, integration and system demonstration), with a technical kickoff expected later this month. CEO Jason Kelly: the challenge is making instruments from six different organizations behave as one controlled, auditable system.
quarterly_data.figure: subcontract for up to $17.5M; approximately twenty analytical instruments; six organizations
